svg.aria-label: Animated expected behaviour of the motor and run lamp
svg.title: Expected behaviour of the motor and run lamp
svg.text: Teal outline = that contact is true now. STOP_PB is true while the STOP button is NOT pressed.
Idle: nothing pressed, motor and lamp OFF
START pressed: motor ON, RUN lamp ON
START released: the seal-in holds the motor, lamp stays ON
STOP pressed: motor OFF, lamp OFF
START and STOP together: STOP wins, lamp stays OFF
